metadata.question: Was water extent in the Sudd wetlands, South Sudan near Bor on December 4, 2021 higher than on December 6, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Sudd wetlands near Bor, South Sudan (~6.2°N, 31.6°E) - Dates: December 4, 2021 vs December 6, 2019 - Collection: Sentinel-1 SAR (good for water detection, cloud-independent) or Sentinel-2/Landsat with water indices - Given specific dates, I'll use daily data if available 2. Masking strategy: - For water extent detection, I'll use Sentinel-1 VV polarization (better for water) or NDWI/MNDWI from optical data - Water typically has low backscatter in SAR or high NDWI values - Cloud masking needed if using optical data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid zero water extent would be B (less water in 2021) - Higher water extent in 2021 would be A - Check if images exist for both dates (C1) - Check if valid pixels remain after processing (C2) - Check if calculations return valid numbers (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location - Sudd wetlands near Bor, South Sudan const bor = ee.Geometry.Point([31.56, 6.21]); const aoi = bor.buffer(20000); // 20km radius around Bor // 2. Define dates const date2019 = '2019-12-06'; const date2021 = '2021-12-04'; // 3. Load Sentinel-1 SAR data (cloud-independent) const s1_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date2019, ee.Date(date2019).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const s1_2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(date2021, ee.Date(date2021).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const size2019 = s1_2019.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = s1_2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 images: ${size2019}, 2021 images: ${size2021}`); // Check if data exists if (size2019 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { // Try wider date range const s1_2019_wide = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2019-12-01', '2019-12-10') .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const s1_2021_wide = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2021-12-01', '2021-12-10') .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const size2019_wide = s1_2019_wide.size().getInfo(); const size2021_wide = s1_2021_wide.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Wider range - 2019: ${size2019_wide}, 2021: ${size2021_wide}`); if (size2019_wide === 0 || size2021_wide === 0) { console.log('No data available for comparison'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Use closest images var img2019 = s1_2019_wide.sort('system:time_start').first(); var img2021 = s1_2021_wide.sort('system:time_start').first(); } else { var img2019 = s1_2019.first(); var img2021 = s1_2021.first(); } // 4. Detect water (VV < -15 dB is typically water) const water2019 = img2019.lt(-15); const water2021 = img2021.lt(-15); // 5. Calculate water extent area const stats2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2021 = water2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels2019 = stats2019.get('VV').getInfo(); const waterPixels2021 = stats2021.get('VV').getInfo(); // Check pixel counts const count2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('VV').getInfo(); const count2021 = water2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('VV').getInfo(); console.log(`2019: Water pixels=${waterPixels2019}, Total pixels=${count2019}`); console.log(`2021: Water pixels=${waterPixels2021}, Total pixels=${count2021}`); // 6. Validation if (count2019 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (waterPixels2019 === null || waterPixels2021 === null || isNaN(waterPixels2019) || isNaN(waterPixels2021)) { console.log('Calculation failure'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare water extent const waterArea2019 = waterPixels2019 * 1e6 / 1e6; // km² const waterArea2021 = waterPixels2021 * 1e6 / 1e6; // km² console.log(`Water extent - 2019: ${waterArea2019.toFixed(2)} km², 2021: ${waterArea2021.toFixed(2)} km²`); if (waterArea2021 > waterArea2019) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
